changelog:
Initial release of the directus-io skill for integrating and managing Directus headless CMS.

- Supports questions on Directus setup, usage, SDKs, API, Astro/Next/SvelteKit/Nuxt integrations, automations, and troubleshooting.
- Organized reference files cover SDK/API, Astro, TypeScript, flows, extensions, data modeling, and error resolution.
- Includes quick-reference setup for SDK usage, Astro integration, and Docker deployment.
- Details key patterns like schema typing, access control, and content/media management with Directus.
